page.overview:
Who is Oikeroi?

Oikeroi was a thane of Tevildo slain by the wolf-hound Huan in "The Tale of Tinúviel", given in The Book of Lost Tales Part Two.

Oikeroi was "a fierce and warlike" cat, counted as one of Tevildo's thanes. As a result of being a thane, he had access to the sunning ground beneath the hill-top halls. As one of Tevildo's thanes, Oikeroi was better than most cats at catching birds and beasts. Oikeroi had often spent so much of his time in Angband that eventually nobody paid attention to him when he was there.

When Beren was first brought to Tevildo, Oikeroi may have been among the thanes who stood with Tevildo and lashed their beautiful tails.

Some time later, after Tinúviel was brought to the dining chamber in the halls and claimed that Huan was lying wounded in the nearby Withered Dale, Tevildo followed her with Oikeroi and another thane. Unlike Umuiyan, Oikeroi carried Tinúviel down the hill-top without falling asleep.
